text:
alex: spotting odd billing rows attributed to org:unknown. looks tied to requests coming through proxy-svc -> auth-exchange. short log paste below.

li: can you paste the raw curl and auth logs?

alex: repro:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sa:abc...\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://api.internal/v1/complete
```
service log: `auth.resolve token=sa-abc principal=sa:abc org=org-111 project=` (project empty)

tess: so the original SA probably had project scoped access but exchange dropped it when minting a proxy token. we recently tightened exchange to strip resource claims for downstream tokens.

li: right. quota and billing prefer a deterministic attribution source. current priority is: 1) signed header from exchange, 2) token.claims.project, 3) X-Org-Project header, 4) org fallback. when project absent we sometimes end up at org:unknown due to a bug in fallback.

alex: proposal: have exchange emit a signed header `X-Auth-Meta` containing origin_project when it's safe to do so (verify SA belongs to project). quota service verifies signature and uses header before claims.

tess: sounds low risk. header is ephemeral and avoids copying resource claims into proxy JWTs. add an audit log when we refuse to include project.

li: implementation notes: check projects cache (read-only) during exchange, if membership validated then add base64json+signature header, else omit and audit. also add sampling tag `debug.auth.project_missing=true` so ops can correlate.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: auth-exchange v2.50 -> canary cluster beta-1 at 2026-04-05T10:30:00Z :rocket:

alex: rollout plan: canary 1% for 6h, monitor attribution panel and quota-deny rates. alert if org:unknown count spikes >2x baseline.

tess: i'll update telemetry to prefer signed header and to surface attribution source in the console panel. also add playbook steps for rollback (disable header mode).

li: opening PR for exchange change; adding unit tests for header signing and verification.

alex: thanks, linking PR/issue here when ready.
